subtitle: 주사위가 안 뜨는 수상한 수도원 파티

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
수도원서 삼위일체 떴는데
제 렙이 낮아서
주사위가 안 뜨네요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3-head-tall Korean comedy webtoon style over-the-shoulder high-angle shot from behind 스카이본 마법사 on the left, with her mage staff neatly stowed across her back. She tilts her head curiously while pointing one empty hand down at a glowing blue rare necklace floating over a tiny defeated Scarlet boss treasure pile on a minimal stone patch. Pure solid white #FFFFFF background.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
주사위는 렙 무관인데?!
당장 초상화 눌러서
전리품 설정 확인해 봐!
cuts.visual_prompt: Extreme low-angle close-up looking up at 타우렌 드루이드 on the right in sleek 3-head-tall Korean comedy webtoon style, her wooden staff stowed on her back. Her eyes widen in sudden suspicion as she leans sharply forward, holding a rustic wooden tavern mug in one hand and pointing urgently with the other. Pure solid white #FFFFFF background.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
'담당자가 주는 템만
습득할 수 있다'는데요?
원래 이런 거 아녜요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Steep bird's-eye high-angle shot looking down at 스카이본 마법사 centered in sleek 3-head-tall Korean comedy webtoon style, with her mage staff stowed across her back. She beams innocently with sparkling star eyes, tilting her head while lightly tapping a small glowing translucent blue quest-scroll icon floating beside her empty hands. Pure solid white #FFFFFF background.

Dramatic Dutch-angle slapstick freeze-frame shot of 타우렌 드루이드 from a low side angle in sleek 3-head-tall Korean comedy webtoon style. She recoils backward off her hooves in exaggerated silent horror, jaw dropped and fur bristling, as her single wooden druid staff slips out of her empty outstretched hands in mid-air above a tiny shadow patch. Pure solid white #FFFFFF background.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
그거 담당자 사기잖아!!
뉴비한테 룻 장난질이라니
당장 파장 누구야, 이름 대!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic side-profile rushing action shot in sleek 3-head-tall Korean comedy webtoon style, with both characters' staves stowed cleanly on their backs. On the left, 타우렌 드루이드 charges forward furiously with clenched fists and swirling green nature leaves, while on the far right, 스카이본 마법사 leans back in startled surprise from a rear three-quarter angle. Pure solid white #FFFFFF background.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
길드원들이 다 난리 치니까
파장님이 땀 뻘뻘 흘리며
바로 주사위로 바꿨대요~
cuts.visual_prompt: Three-quarter rear-view shot with turned head of 스카이본 마법사 on the right in sleek 3-head-tall Korean comedy webtoon style, her mage staff stowed across her back. She smiles brightly over her shoulder while tossing a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube showing ONLY classic round dot pips, strictly ZERO digits, ZERO numbers, ZERO letters in one hand, as a tiny sweating shadowy silhouette of the guilty party leader shrinks away on the far left. Pure solid white #FFFFFF background.
